purpose: Offers one primary action with a few related alternatives behind a caret, such as Publish next to Publish and notify or Save as draft. Use it once per toolbar or page header.

notFor.case: There is a single action with no alternatives.
Several actions where none is primary.
Two to five related actions or views that read as one control.

Open=false.visual: Two ButtonGroupItem segments in the brand fill (default) or the neutral fill (secondary); the caret shows CaretDown.

Open=true.meaning: The menu of alternatives is shown.
Open=true.visual: The caret segment is pinned Active and shows CaretUp; the DropdownMenu opens below, aligned to the end edge.

a11y.role: two native <button>s; the caret has aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded and opens a Radix DropdownMenu
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches each segment; Enter or Space runs the main action or opens the menu. In the menu, arrows move and loop, typeahead jumps, Escape closes and returns focus to the caret.
a11y.reducedMotion: Only the fade is kept: the menu does not grow out of the caret and its rows do not stagger.
notes: The caret is named "<label> more actions" by default.
The main segment is a plain action, never aria-pressed.
In Dark the default label on the violet fill is judged by APCA, as on Button; a WCAG checker reads about 4.0:1 there by design.
The pair never collapses; on narrow screens give it its own row.

openQuestions: Contrast: the default Variant in Dark reads about 4.0:1 under WCAG and passes only by APCA. Is AA (WCAG) the promise, or APCA?
Disabled: there is no disabled variant in the Figma set; is disabling both segments with ButtonGroupItem's Disabled look the intended treatment?
